title: 第二章 线上豪言壮语，线下胡言乱语
slug: 什么网恋的清冷校花竟是双胞胎
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

男生宿舍楼，1357宿舍，宿舍里其余的床位空荡荡的，只有靠窗的床位旁摆着两个行李箱，桌子上放着一个电脑包和一个灰色书包。

陈舟刚放好行李，一想到等会要和柠柠一起吃饭，心就砰砰直跳。

第一次见面吃饭不会见光死吧，不会到时候柠柠要给我划清界限了吧。

但不应该啊，刚刚她还对我笑了，应该不会吧。

这一通胡思乱想，陈舟连忙从椅子上坐起来，跑到卫生间的镜子前，用手摸了摸发型。

啊，怎么办，头发有点塌了。

他又把脸凑到镜子前，用手擦了擦有些斑驳的镜子，仔细检查了检查。

除了头发有点塌好像也没啥吧，应该不会吧。

陈舟连忙拿出发胶啥的又给整理了一下头发，凑到镜子前看了看。

哎，可算好了。

收起手机后，陈舟再次检查了一下自己的形象，把衣领翻出来，拍了拍胸口，呼出一口气。

随后，陈舟从卫生间走到自己座位旁，背着书包就走了。

一切准备就绪后，陈舟拿起礼物袋，拿着钥匙，推开门，下了楼。

男生宿舍楼下满是迎来送往的新生和新生家长，张晚柠坐在男生宿舍楼下的长椅上，脸上又恢复了刚刚迎新时的清冷，给人一种拒人千里之外的感觉，但又美得让人移不开眼。

路过的学生即便是跟着家长在一起，也时不时地朝她看一眼，心里都在暗暗感叹。

“真好看啊。”

陈舟好不容易从新生和新生家长里挤了出来，站在宿舍门口张望了好一会，才找到柠柠，虽然刚刚已经偷偷看了好多次，可再看到还是忍不住惊叹。

她安安静静地坐在那里，修长的手指摆弄着手机，如画的眉眼露出淡淡的疏离感，如同下凡的仙女一般，只可远观。

但陈舟也没想那么多，毕竟他和柠柠都网恋了一年多了，什么话没说过，“宝宝，宝贝”的都不知道叫了几千遍了，甚至有时候到兴头上还有更亲密的呢。

陈舟检查了一下自己的书包，见一切东西都已经准备好了之后，直接穿过人群走到了长椅旁边。

周围的学生停下脚步，都看向了陈舟这边，心里都在想“啊？这哥们这么勇的吗？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the boys' dormitory building, Dormitory 1357, the rest of the beds in the dormitory were empty. There were only two suitcases next to the bed by the window, and a computer bag and a gray schoolbag on the table.

Chen Zhou had just put away his luggage, and his heart was beating fast at the thought of having dinner with Ning Ning later.

The first time we meet for dinner, I won’t die in public. Isn’t Ning Ning going to draw a clear line for me then?

But it shouldn't be. She smiled at me just now, so it shouldn't be.

After all these random thoughts, Chen Zhou quickly sat up from his chair, ran to the bathroom mirror, and touched his hair style with his hands.

Ah, what should I do? My hair is a little flat.

He put his face in front of the mirror again, wiped the mottled mirror with his hand, and examined it carefully.

It seems like there's nothing wrong with it except that my hair is a little flat, probably not.

Chen Zhou quickly took out some hairspray and tidied his hair, then went to the mirror and took a look.

Oh, that's good.

After putting away his phone, Chen Zhou checked his image again, turned his collar over, patted his chest, and exhaled.

Afterwards, Chen Zhou walked from the bathroom to his seat, carried his schoolbag and left.

After everything was ready, Chen Zhou picked up the gift bag, took the key, opened the door, and went downstairs.

The downstairs of the boys' dormitory was full of freshmen and their parents welcoming new students. Zhang Wanning was sitting on the bench downstairs of the boys' dormitory. Her face had regained the coldness it had when she had just welcomed the new students, giving people a feeling of being thousands of miles away, but she was so beautiful that people couldn't take their eyes away.

The passing students, even if they were with their parents, glanced at her from time to time, sighing secretly in their hearts.

"It's so beautiful."

Chen Zhou finally squeezed out from the freshmen and their parents. He stood at the door of the dormitory and looked around for a long time before he found Ning Ning. Although he had peeked at Ning Ning many times just now, he still couldn't help but be amazed when he saw her again.

She sat there quietly, fiddling with her phone with her slender fingers, her picturesque eyebrows showing a slight sense of alienation, like a fairy descending to earth, who could only be viewed from a distance.

But Chen Zhou didn't think too much about it. After all, he and Ning Ning had been dating online for more than a year. They had never said anything. They called "baby, baby" thousands of times. Sometimes they even got closer to each other when they were in the mood.

Chen Zhou checked his schoolbag. After seeing that everything was ready, he walked directly through the crowd to the bench.

The students around him stopped and looked at Chen Zhou, thinking, "Huh? Is this guy so brave?"
